walkthroughs.body_html: The histogram shows how many pixels sit at each brightness. Spikes touching the left edge mean shadow clipping; spikes on the right mean highlight clipping. A balanced exposure usually fills the graph without pushing against either end.

Drag the black point slider in to where the shadow data begins and the white point slider in to where the highlight data ends. This adds contrast. The middle slider shifts mid-tones lighter or darker without moving the endpoints.
Use adjustment layers rather than baking changes onto the photo. You can re-edit them later, mask them to part of the image, or turn them off. Always keep the original file untouched as a master.
